mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 4 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 11, low -1.

Former NBA champion Lamar Odom has joined OnlyFans, earning more than 45,000 euros in his first eight days and is expected to make over 180,000 euros overall.

A 58-year-old man was found dead on the Beliçica road in Gostivar; his body has been sent to the Tetovo forensic institute for an autopsy.

Police in Tirana used high-pressure water jets to break up a protest that had escalated with improvised weapons and pyrotechnics, dispersing the demonstrators on the main boulevard.

Twenty-three correctional officers from Kosovo have begun assignments in three Danish prisons, a move aimed at easing Denmark's prison overcrowding and staff shortages.

A new smart ring called the Aina Ring adds a built-in display, eliminating the need to rely on a smartphone for many functions and expanding the capabilities of wearable tech.
